notes:
Summary: stalled → performance technical fit issue. Primary ask: sub-150ms p95 for chat streaming in-store assistants (low-latency in-aisle use). POC ran Aug–Oct on dedicated pool. Outcome: p95 consistently 230–320ms on typical queries with spikes during burst windows; streaming sessions show token delivery jitter and occasional truncated streams. They flag UX regressions: 'users feel it's laggy' and 'cannot risk latency during checkout flows.'

Timeline (key bullets):
- 2024-08-15: Intro call (AE Marcus) — discovered in-aisle assistant + web chat plans; interested in dedicated for data isolation.
- 2024-08-29: SE scoping (Priya) — requested target p95 <=150ms, 95th percentile measured on 99th token cutoff, throughput target 200 reqs/min.
- 2024-09-12: POC kickoff (Fireflies ff_2024-09-12-0283). Baseline tests with hosted small model.
- 2024-10-03: Mid-POC review — observed p95 ~260ms, streaming jitter on long responses, opened INF-3241 for investigation.
- 2024-10-20: Deep perf analysis call (Fireflies ff_2024-10-20-0911). Kernel selection and batching profile adjusted; marginal improvements only.
- 2024-11-01: Security & procurement pause — internal budget freeze flagged; competitor (OpenAI) offered lower-latency edge config for trial.

Customer quotes / call snippets: "The latency feels noticeable on the floor — associates complain."; "If we can't meet <150ms p95 we can't replace our current widget."

Technical notes (what failed):
- p95 latency > target. Measured 230–320ms across representative query mix (short to medium tokens).
- Streaming integration: token-by-token jitter; some clients see truncated SSE events under burst.
- Batching trade-offs: increasing batch window reduced cost but worsened p95; continuous batching parameters tuned during POC with limited win.
- Kernel/hardware: tests run on g4-dedicated pool mimic; profiling suggests KV-cache misses and suboptimal kernel for streaming path on longer sequences.

Competitive / commercial context:
- They trialed competitor edge endpoint that returned p95 ~120–140ms in lab with similar payloads; marketing + price discounts in play.
- Internal champion (VP Product) is overloaded; no exec-level sponsor after hiring freeze — risk of drift to competitor or procurement stall.
